title: Ave, rabbi
html_source: Hail rabbi. Gifford mentions Matthew 26:49 ie one to act as Judas did.

 Cranly's eleven true Wicklowmen to free their sireland. Gaptoothed Kathleen, her four beautiful green fields, the stranger 1961#184in her house. And one more to hail him:
anchor.suffix:
: the Tinahely twelve. In the shadow of the glen he cooees for them. My soul's youth I gave him, night by night. Godspeed. Good hunting. 

 Mulligan has my telegram. 

 Folly. Pers
